name: Classic Peruvian-Style Fish Ceviche

instructions.primary_message: Combine fish, juice, onion, cilantro, and jalapeño in a large bowl and gently fold with your hands to combine. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Allow to marinate for at least 5 minutes, folding occasionally. (See chart and image above for marinating time guidance.) Transfer to a serving platter and serve immediately with boiled corn and sweet potatoes, if desired.

schema_metadata.keywords: appetizers, ceviche, fish, The Food Lab

description: Sashimi and crudo may be the John and Paul of the raw seafood band, but ceviche is the George. A little less popular, a little less flashy, but altogether more complex, sharper, and complex, with a bit of acid. It differs from George in one key way though: It's really easy to get into.
notes:
Optional substitutions: lemon orange juice → lime orange juice or sour orange juice

Notes: Use the freshest fish available. Medium shrimp or scallops cut into 1.5-cm chunks can be substituted for fish.
author: J. Kenji López-Alt
